task: Create the canonical FrankX changelog and release-note experience.
surface: Responsive changelog index, update detail pages, and RSS discovery surface.
audience: Builders, customers, partners, journalists, and search or answer engines evaluating FrankX stewardship.
first_read: FrankX ships meaningful work in public, and every claim has a receipt.

references.label: FrankX production design kernel
references.reason: Defines the frozen FrankX typography, color, hierarchy, and anti-slop constraints.

references.label: Public GitHub merge evidence
references.reason: Provides inspectable receipts for every editorial release claim.

keep: Void-black FrankX chrome and restrained tech accents
Editorial hierarchy with visible dates and human-readable outcomes
avoid: Generic gradients, glassmorphism, animated counters, and generated filler
direction.signature: An evidence rail connects each release headline to its public receipts.
system: Poppins headings, Inter body, and JetBrains Mono evidence labels
Void black, hairline white borders, emerald current-state signal, cyan proof links
Asymmetric desktop ledger that collapses into a single mobile reading flow
CSS focus and hover transitions only

asset_quality.why_premium: The correct premium medium is an exact, fast, accessible editorial system whose claims can be inspected directly.

checks.name: asset-tier
checks.evidence: Tier C exact UI is the correct medium; public GitHub receipts are Tier A proof content.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: Desktop and mobile exports have not yet been captured.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: Implementation and responsive review are pending.

score.notes: Score after implementation and export inspection.

known_risks: Historical merged work may not map one-to-one to currently reachable public routes; proof copy stays scoped to merged changes until live verification.
